Name: Candace
Dialog: (singsong) Hey, Mom!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Mrs. Flynn.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, when can I get a car?

Name: Linda
Dialog: (skates by, dressed as a 50s waitress) Candace, you only have your learner's permit.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, but eventually, I'm gonna have my license. I think we should be ready.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (skates by) Riiiight. In the meantime, have a cookie!

Name: Candace
Dialog: That's hardly the same thing. Why are you dressed like that?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Don't you remember? The Doo Wop Hop is tonight. All the neighborhood moms have volunteered to be carhops.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Wow, Mrs. Flynn, I really like the wig helmet. (eats a cookie)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Why, thank you, Jeremy. Safety first, you know. (leaves)

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: (to Candace) I don't know about you, but I'm gonna have another cookie. (eats another cookie)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (off-screen) Aloha, cats!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Oh, hey, guys. How are you doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Mellow like a cello and solid to boot, daddy-o. We're going to the Doo Wop Hop tonight, so we're dressed like they did in the fifties. You know, when everyone dressed like a sitcom from the seventies? Right, Ferb?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (enters from garage) Boys, have you seen my welder?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb and I were using it to put the finishing touches on his shades. Right, Ferb?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, yes, those are very hip.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What have you been working on all night out there, Dad?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: It's a surprise for Candace uh—oops! Uh...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, this conversation suddenly interests me. What are you making me?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, Lawrence, sounds like you'd better tell her!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, I wanted it to be a surprise, but I bought you a car!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: No way.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Really?! A car?!!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (leads them into the garage) Oh, yes. It's the same car I had when I was a lad. I figured it would be ready when you were old enough.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, what do you mean, "ready"?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, uh, it's not fully restored, yet.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ya think?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Mr. Fletcher, is that a Nedlington Nymph?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Why yes, yes it is! Jeremy, you have your license, don't you? You can take Candace for a ride in it when it's finished.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Awesome.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb and I think it's cool, too. Ferb, tell them what you told me.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Right?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm living in Crazy Town, and Phineas and Ferb are town council.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Heeeeeyy. Where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: What's shakin', bacon? (camera reveals Major Monogram dressed up '50s-style) Like the threads? Carl and I are going to cruise over to the Doo Wop Hop tonight. We're going incognito. Maybe do a little reconnaissance while I take in the car show.

Name: Carl
Dialog: And he really just wants to spy on Monty to find out what kind of girl he's dating.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Wrong! Wrong, Carl! We happen to know that Doofenshmirtz has entered a car in the competition. He must be up to something. And if I should happen to see who my son is dating, well, where's the harm in that? Hmm? Meanwhile, we need you to find out what the heck Doof is building, validate its evilness, and destroy it. (Agent P salutes) Good luck, Agent P, and see ya later, crocodile!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, sometimes evil just cracks me up! (He hears Vanessa humming) Say where's that humming coming from?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Vanessa, is that you? Are you okay?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: What do you mean, Dad?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Something's not right. The corners of your mouth are pointing up. (feeling her forehead) Maybe you're running a fever.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Relax, will you? I'm just looking forward to the '50s Doo Wop Hop tonight.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: So who are you going with?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Oh, you know, just a friend.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Speaking of friends, I think you have a little visitor.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, he can wait. So what friend? Is it that girl with the dark hair who has all those dachshunds?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (approaching the door) No. It's a...different...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait! No no no! Don't open the door! You'll let in Perry the Platypus!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: You know he'll just blow the door down if you don't open it. (opens door revealing Perry holding a bazooka) Come in, Perry. Toodles! (she leaves)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm worried about her, Perry the Platypus. Hey! You were going to blow down my door! (Perry sets the bazooka down, but accidentally fires it leaving a big hole in a Warholian picture of Doofenshmirtz.) Oh, great! See, this is why I can't have anything nice! Anyway, c'mon, let me show you what I've been workin' on. Y'see, it all started when I was just a small boy back in Gimmelshtump.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover) Friday was always Cruise Night and everybody would come out to see the hipsters and their cool cars made from cannibalized parts left over from Drusselstein's many foreign occupations. But for me...

Name: Young Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oooooh!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover) ...the coolest car of all was the Boomshlaka 320-I, run by my Uncle Simpkin!

Name: Young Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah! You go! You show them how you're more masculine than everyone else!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover, talking over his younger self) To me, it was the coolest car ever!

Name: Young Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Booyah!

Name: Uncle Simpkin
Dialog: Hey! (taking off his shirt and throwing it into the crowd)

Name: Female Fan
Dialog: I saw it first! I saw it first!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover) Unfortunately, the car had one major design flaw: The back bumper was a surplus dynamite plunger and the gas tank sat directly under the driver's seat.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (voiceover) And I never saw him again.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But I have been able to restore his car. (Cut to a dust cover being lifted revealing the car) The 1957 Drusselstein Boomshlaka 320-I! Mmmwah! Ain't she a honey? I'm sure to win first prize with this. And here's the good part! (He pushes a button on a remote, causing jumper cables to come out of the grill trapping Perry. Doofenshmirtz laughs) Trapper cables! I needed to restrain you for this next part because it does get a little bit evil. Just to ensure there's no real competition, I built a little gadget called the Rustinator. At the push of a button, it will reduce every other car into red dust! Or rust. Wait, red dust, rust. I wonder if that's where that word came from. (exits) I'm gonna go look up its entomology. (returns) Yeah, I looked it up. It turns out "entomology" is the study of insects. Go figure. Anyway, uh, in you go! (The cables put Perry inside the vehicle.) I'll just get in the normal way. (Cut to the driver's seat) How's it goin' down there? Cozy in your steel cables? Careful with the Rustinator, Norm! (Cut to reveal Norm buckled up holding the Rustinator) We wouldn't want it to go off inadvertently.

Name: Norm
Dialog: No problemo!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Boy, Ferb, Dad was right. That muffler sure is making some weird noises.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Uh, we'd best leave him be. Ferb, show me the model you've been workin' on. Were you able to add any extras?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, Candace is gonna love that...I mean except for the exploding part. We should probably fix that.

Name: Vivian
Dialog: ¡Hola, Candace! Ooh, don't you look lovely!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Thank you, Mrs. Garcia-Shapiro!

Name: Mrs. Johnson
Dialog: Jeremy'll be along in a minute, honey!

Name: Vivian
Dialog: Is your mother ready?

Name: Candace
Dialog: She'll be right out.

Name: Linda
Dialog: All set! See ya there, Candace! Okay, ladies, here I come! (She skates away) Hehehe! There I go! Ha ha! Sorry! Can't stop. FOLLOW MEEEEEEEEEEEEEE....

Name: Mrs. Johnson
Dialog: Step on it, Vivian, she's getting away!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Hey, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: My car broke down.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, I guess we're riding our bikes to the car show. (They walk to the garage) We can wow them with our irony.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (angrily) You guys are so... (excitedly) AWESOME!! Wow! I never thought it'd turn out so beautiful! Right?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: How's the engine sound?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (tossing Jeremy the keys) You tell me! Dad did say you could drive it when it was finished.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, where is Dad anyway?

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Hmm. Well, last we saw him, he was working on the muffler.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Out of my way, luge boy!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Maybe he's already on his way to the hop.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Okay, well, maybe we should get goin'. Hop in, everyone! We're goin' cruisin'!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Ooh, look! The visor's a vanity!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: My car has a turret that goes...

Name: Linda
Dialog: Whoo-hoo-hoo!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Follow me, we're almost there!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Let's deploy the chutes, Ferb!

Name: All
Dialog: Yeah!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ha! This is gonna be a piece of cake! (The tank rolls onto the stage.) I rule! (Confetti comes out. Everyone laughs.) I don't get it, what's the joke? Why is everyone laughing?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I can't find Monty. Get up on my shoulders, Carl! See if you can see him!

Name: Carl
Dialog: You're not gonna drop me again, are you?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Just do it, Carl! And watch the hair. Take these. (Carl gets on Monogram's shoulders and takes the binoculars.) Now what do ya see?

Name: Carl
Dialog: There he is! (POV shot from the binoculars to show Monty next to Vanessa) And he's with—Oh no! (Monty looks in terror and shushes Carl)

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: What-wh-Carl! What do you see?

Name: Carl
Dialog: Someone who owes me big time!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: They dare to laugh at the Drusselstein Boomshlaka 320-I? Well, we'll just see who has the last laugh! Norm, fire up the Rustinator!

Name: Norm
Dialog: (saluting) Firing away, sir! Now, how do I set the coordinates? Hmmmm... (Perry pushes a button with the Boomshlaka 320-I on it) Thank you, Perry the Platypus! Very sporting of you! (The Rustinator activates rusting up the vehicle)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Uh-oh! Well, thank goodness for the plastic gas tank. (to Vanessa) Hey, Vanessa?! Is that you?!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Hi, Dad!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait a minute! Who's that boy you're with? He looks vaguely familiar. (Perry pushes a button on the gas tank) Say, isn't that— (The tank explodes sending Doofenshmirtz into orbit) AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHH!!! (a man passes by him) Uncle Simpkin? He's looking well.

Name: Stanky Dog
Dialog: Up next is a late entry. Wow! I don't believe it! Look at this, folks! (a mechanical hand emerges from the car. Candace takes it and walks out) Is that a Nedlington Nymph?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes. Yes, it is.

Name: Stanky Dog
Dialog: And who did this amazing restoration?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, my dad's been working on it for a while and...oh, here he is!

Name: Stanky Dog
Dialog: Look at that, folks! Workin' on it up to the last second!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: I was?

Name: Stanky Dog
Dialog: Well, I think I speak for all the judges when I say the Nedlington Nymph wins Best in Show!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: What an honor! Here, Candace! It is your car after all!

Name: Linda
Dialog: (skating up to her husband) A one of a kind car for a one of a kind girl!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Aw, you guys!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Oh, dear, you're rolling away!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (giving the trophy to her brothers) This really goes to you, you know.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Cool! You were right, Ferb, it really did need a trophy shelf! (Perry emerges from inside the cup chattering) Oh, there you are, Perry!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: My car has a turret that goes...

Name: Linda
Dialog: Whoo-hoo-hoo!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Follow me, we're almost there!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Let's deploy the chutes, Ferb!
